About this page

  • Each lane is a program that sent to this account in these days; each mark is one email on one day, as large as the sends it was, filled when at least one was opened, plain when delivered and none opened, a ring when none was delivered. Hover or tap a mark for its program, step, subject and counts.
  • The Programs filter keeps the lanes you choose; the Recipients switch leaves out internal recipients. The address bar keeps the filters, so a view can be bookmarked; Reset filters clears them.
  • Download current view (CSV) exports the sends table as it stands. The summary's open rate stands beside every recipient of the same programs over the same days.

Definitions

Sent
Every email attempt in the period, whether or not it went out. Every recipient and every repeat send counts. Calculation: COUNT of rows. Read from email_log_v2, every row (no field condition); filters Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"; date field ExecutedDate, by day.
Delivered
Attempts that went out and did not bounce. An attempt that went out and bounced afterwards counts as bounced, not delivered. Calculation: COUNT of rows. Read from email_log_v2, IsSent = YES and IsBounced is not YES; filters Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"; date field ExecutedDate, by day.
Bounced
Attempts flagged as bounced, counted as events, whether or not the attempt went out. Calculation: COUNT of rows. Read from email_log_v2, IsBounced = YES; filters Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"; date field ExecutedDate, by day.
Opened
Attempts flagged as opened. An open is an image-pixel load. Calculation: COUNT of rows. Read from email_log_v2, IsOpened = YES; filters Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"; date field ExecutedDate, by day.
Open rate
The share of delivered attempts that were opened. Calculation: Opened ÷ Delivered Blank, never 0%, when Delivered is 0. Read from email_log_v2, Opened: IsOpened = YES. Delivered: IsSent = YES and IsBounced is not YES.; filters Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"; date field ExecutedDate, by day.

Pulling it again

This page is not live. To pull it again, run this line in a terminal in the workspace folder after gs-admin login (a login lasts about an hour):

node .gs-superadmin/plugin/scripts/dashboard.mjs account program-health --account-id co-01 --kb acme-prod

Caveats (8)
  • Step names come from the knowledge base, as of the date each program was last documented (the oldest is 2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z). A step renamed since then shows its earlier name.
  • Subjects are each template's CURRENT subject as the knowledge base holds it (the oldest doc is as of 2026-08-20), not necessarily what was sent.
  • Sends on or after 2026-09-01 are provisional: opens keep arriving, so the recent period reads low.
  • Opens are image-pixel loads. Apple Mail Privacy Protection and security scanners inflate them, and blocked images hide real ones. Compare programs with each other, not with an outside benchmark.
  • Open rate and click rate divide by Delivered (went out and did not bounce). A send that was opened and bounced afterwards counts as opened and not delivered, which can lift the rate of a very small group.
  • Every figure is per account: the sends to the account's contacts are added up by program, email and day, and no contact is named. A mark is every send of one email to the account on one day; its size is how many sends that was.
  • The comparison open rate is every recipient of the same programs over the same days, this account's sends included, under the same recipients filter.
  • Program status is today's status. There is no status history.
